name: diataxis
description: Documentation authoring and auditing with Diátaxis, the four-type framework by Daniele Procida (tutorials, how-to guides, reference, explanation). Ships a diataxis skill that forces the reader's need to be named before a word is written, gives per-type writing rules, title conventions and language patterns, a diagnosis pass for documentation that has blurred its types, and a mapping onto R package, pkgdown, Quarto and Sphinx/MkDocs layouts.
